arXiv:2604.21809v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 4 月 23 日arXiv:2604.21809v1 [cs.LG] 23 Apr 2026

商空间扩散模型Quotient-Space Diffusion Models

Yixian Xu1,  Yusong Wang2,5∗,  Shengjie Luo1,  Kaiyuan Gao3,  Tianyu He4, Di He1,  Chang Liu5†
1 State Key Laboratory of General Artificial Intelligence, Peking University, Beijing, China
2 State Key Laboratory of Human-Machine Hybrid Augmented Intelligence, Institute of Artificial
2 Intelligence and Robotics, Xi’an Jiaotong University
3 Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, China
4 Microsoft Research Asia, Beijing, China
5 Zhongguancun Academy, Beijing, China Equal contribution.Correspondence to: Di He <dihe@pku.edu.cn>, Chang Liu <liuchang@bza.edu.cn>.
摘要Abstract

基于扩散的生成模型改革了生成式人工智能，并在科学领域实现了新的功能，例如生成分子的 3D 结构。 由于某些任务的内在问题结构，通常会出现Diffusion-based generative models have reformed generative AI, and have enabled new capabilities in the science domain, for example, generating 3D structures of molecules. Due to the intrinsic problem structure of certain tasks, there is often a对称性symmetry在系统中，它将可以通过组动作转换为等价的对象识别为等价物，因此目标分布本质上是在in the system, which identifies objects that can be converted by a group action as equivalent, hence the target distribution is essentially defined on the商空间quotient space就团体而言。 在这项工作中，我们建立了一个在一般商空间上进行扩散建模的正式框架，并将其应用于遵循特殊欧几里德群的分子结构生成with respect to the group. In this work, we establish a formal framework for diffusion modeling on a general quotient space, and apply it to molecular structure generation which follows the special Euclidean groupSE​(3)\mathrm{SE}(3)对称性。 该框架减少了学习与群体行为相对应的组件的必要性，从而简化了传统群体等变扩散模型的学习难度，并且采样器保证恢复目标分布，而启发式对齐策略缺乏适当的采样器。 这些论点在小分子和蛋白质的结构生成上得到了实证验证，表明原则商空间扩散模型提供了一个优于以前对称处理的新框架。symmetry. The framework reduces the necessity of learning the component corresponding to the group action, hence simplifies learning difficulty over conventional group-equivariant diffusion models, and the sampler guarantees recovering the target distribution, while heuristic alignment strategies lack proper samplers. The arguments are empirically validated on structure generation for small molecules and proteins, indicating that the principled quotient-space diffusion model provides a new framework that outperforms previous symmetry treatments.

1 简介Introduction

扩散模型已成为高维空间中分布建模的主要方法。 以他们在图像等现实领域的成功为基础Diffusion models have emerged as the dominant approach for modeling distributions in high-dimensional spaces. Building on their success in real-world domains such as images(ho2020denoising; song2021score), 音频, audios(kong2021diffwave; evans2024fast)和视频, and videos(ho2022imagen; li2023videogen)，扩散模型现在越来越多地在科学应用中采用，从流体场求解到, diffusion models are now increasingly adopted in scientific applications, ranging from fluid field solving(bastek2025physicsinformed), 电子结构预测, electronic structure prediction(kim2025high), 分子结构生成, molecular structure generation(xu2022geodiff; abramson2024accurate; hassan2024flow; geffner2025proteina)和热力学系综建模, and thermodynamic ensemble modeling(zheng2024predicting; lewis2025scalable).

与一般任务相比， 科学应用常常表现出固有的Compared with general tasks, scientific applications often exhibit inherent对称性symmetry结构，其中可以通过特定变换关联的对象被视为等效的。 以分子结构生成为例。分子结构可以表示为向量structures, wherein objects that can be related through specific transformations are regarded as equivalent. Consider molecular structure generation as a representative example. A molecular structure can be represented as a vector inR3​N\mathbb{R}^{3N}通过连接其 3D 坐标by concatenating the 3D coordinates of itsNN原子。然而，由于坐标系的选择是任意的，向量atoms. However, because the choice of coordinate system is arbitrary, vectors inR3​N\mathbb{R}^{3N}唯一不同之处在于所有原子的全局 3D 平移或旋转都对应于相同的基础结构。从数学上讲，这种变换通常形成李群——例如特殊的欧几里得群that differ only by a global 3D translation or rotation of all atoms correspond to the same underlying structure. Mathematically, such transformations typically form a Lie group — for example, the special Euclidean groupSE​(3)\mathrm{SE}(3)就分子结构而言，它形式上表征了对称性。in the case of molecular structures, which formally characterizes the symmetry.

常见治疗方法 将目标分布放在原始空间中，但将相同的概率分配给等效对象，从而得到在群体作用下不变的分布。 这可以通过应用随机选择的群体动作来增加训练数据来实现The common treatment is putting the target distribution in the original space but assigning the same probability to equivalent objects, resulting in a distribution that is invariant under group action. This can be implemented by augmenting training data by applying randomly chosen group actions(abramson2024accurate)，或使用群等变模型, or using a group equivariant model(xu2022geodiff; hoogeboom22equivariant)，如果起始先验分布不变，则保证不变性, which guarantees invariance if the starting prior distribution is invariant(kohler2020equivariant)。 尽管如此，我们将证明这种治疗方法仍有改进的空间， 由于神经网络模型的目的是在每个扩散模拟步骤中更新样本，因此仍然需要学习. Nevertheless, we shall show that this treatment still has room to improve, as the neural network model, which is intended for updating the sample in each diffusion simulation step, still needs to learn a具体的specific等价类内的运动（movement within the equivalence class (例如e.g.，旋转分子结构），这是不必要的，因为, rotating a molecular structure), which is unnecessary as任何any这样的运动不会更新内在的系统状态（such a movement does not update the intrinsic system state (例如e.g.，分子结构的形状）因此是可以接受的。 为了消除这种冗余，有一些使用对齐的启发式处理，, the shape of a molecular structure) hence is acceptable. In hope to remove this redundancy, there are a few heuristic treatments using alignment,即i.e.，在其等价类内调整预测目标 根据参考文献删除这些等效的自由度, adjusting the prediction target within its equivalence class according to a reference to remove these equivalent degrees of freedom(xu2022geodiff; abramson2024accurate)。 但我们发现相应的采样过程与此类训练策略不兼容，即使进行启发式修复尝试也是如此. But we find that the corresponding sampling process becomes incompatible with such training strategies, even with heuristic fix attempts(wohlwend2025boltz).

在这部作品中， 考虑到系统的内在对称性，我们开发了一种建立扩散模型的原则方法。 特别是，我们利用以下概念：In this work, we develop a principled approach to building a diffusion model considering the intrinsic symmetry of the system. In particular, we leverage the concept of商空间quotient space，其中一组等效对象（等效类）被视为一个元素。它是反映系统内在可变性的形式数学结构。 我们首先根据两个空间上维纳过程之间的对应关系推导一般商空间上的扩散过程。考虑到商空间一般不是欧氏空间，因此很难 直接对其进行模拟，我们进一步利用水平升力的数学结构来诱导回到原始空间的扩散过程，可以轻松实现 商空间扩散过程。由此产生的过程实际上相当于将原始扩散过程中的更新向量投影到子空间上，该子空间不会引起等价类内的移动（, in which a set of equivalent objects (equivalence class) are treated as one element. It is the formal mathematical construction that reflects the intrinsic variability of the system. We first derive the diffusion process on a general quotient space based on the correspondence between the Wiener processes on the two spaces. Considering that the quotient space is generally not Euclidean, hence it is hard to directly carry out a simulation on it, we further leverage the mathematical construction of horizontal lift to induce a diffusion process back in the original space that can easily implement the quotient-space diffusion process. The resulting process effectively amounts to projecting the update vector in the original diffusion process onto the subspace that does not induce a movement within the equivalence class (例如e.g.，旋转）。 我们证明这个过程, rotation). We show that this process保证产生正确的目标分布guarantees producing the correct target distribution，同时, meanwhile降低学习难度reduces learning difficulty通过消除在同等课程中学习特定动作的必要性。 二维平面中的可视化示例by removing the necessity to learn a specific movement within an equivalence class. A visualization example in the 2-dimensional plane withSO​(2)\mathrm{SO}(2)对称性如图所示。symmetry is shown in Fig.1。在此示例中，提升过程仅具有径向运动（图 1）。. In this example, the lifted process only has radial movements (Fig.1(左)) 作为商空间(Left)) as the quotient spaceR2/SO​(2)\mathbb{R}^{2}/\mathrm{SO}(2)与半实数线同构，并恢复正确的目标分布作为传统的等变扩散模型（图 1）。is isomorphic to the half real line and recovers the correct target distribution as conventional equivariant diffusion models (Fig.1（中，右））。与现有方法的概念比较如表所示(Middle, Right)). A conceptual comparison with existing methods is shown in Table1。 商空间扩散允许等变模型或具有数据增强的一般模型。. The quotient-space diffusion admits either an equivariant model or a general model with data augmentation.

作为代表性应用，我们推导了具体的训练和采样算法As a representative application, we deduce the specific training and sampling algorithms in theR3​N/SE​(3)\mathbb{R}^{3N}/\mathrm{SE}(3)分子结构生成的场景，它使模型免于学习平移和旋转运动，而采样过程使结构保持恒定的位置和方向。 我们研究了商空间扩散模型在小分子结构生成和蛋白质主链设计任务上的经验表现。结果表明，与传统的等变扩散模型和使用对齐策略相比，我们的方法可以持续提高这些应用中的生成性能。 我们的方法实现了 ET-Flow 9%-23% 的相对改进scenario for molecular structure generation, which relaxes the model from learning a translation and rotation movement, while the sampling process keeps the structure with constant position and orientation. We study the empirical performance of quotient-space diffusion models on small molecule structure generation and protein backbone design tasks. The results show that our methods can consistently improve the generation performance in these applications over conventional equivariant diffusion models and using alignment strategies. Our method achieves 9%-23% relative improvements of ET-Flow(hassan2024flow)在 GEOM-QM9 和 GEOM-DRUGS 数据集上，超越了以前的启发式对齐方法。对于蛋白质结构生成任务，我们的方法超越了最先进的 Proteína 模型on GEOM-QM9 and GEOM-DRUGS datasets, surpassing previous heuristic alignment methods. For the protein structure generation task, our method surpasses the state-of-the-art Proteína model(geffner2025proteina)具有相同的参数规模（60M），并且在大多数关键分布指标上也优于更大的模型（200M）。with the same parameter scale (60M) in a large margin and also outperforms the much larger model (200M) on most key distributional metrics.

2.2 从欧几里得空间到商流形From Euclidean Space to Quotient Manifold

科学领域的任务通常涉及固有的对称性，其中通过某些变换相关的对象被认为是等效的。 对系统中对称性的正式和包容性描述需要配置空间的几何结构和变换的代数结构，这导致了流形和李群的概念。Tasks in scientific domains often involve inherent symmetry, where objects related by certain transformations are considered equivalent. A formal and inclusive description of symmetry in a system requires both the geometry of the configuration space and the algebraic structure of the transformations, which leads to the concepts of manifolds and Lie groups.

流形和李群。Manifold and Lie groups.（平滑）流形是一种几何对象，它概括了欧几里得空间以允许空间异质性。通常，流形被赋予黎曼度量，A (smooth) manifold is a geometric object that generalizes the Euclidean space to allow spatial heterogeneity. Typically, a manifold is endowed with a Riemannian metric,即i.e.，每个切空间中的内积，这导致了流形上的曲线长度、距离、度量、梯度、拉普拉斯和维纳过程等常见概念（Appx.1）。, an inner product in each tangent space, which leads to common concepts like curve length, distance, measure, gradient, Laplacian, and Wiener process on the manifold (Appx.B.1）。 对称性通过连接等价的变换来正式表示（). Symmetries are formally represented by transformations that connect equivalent (即i.e.，对称）对象，构成一个群。 连续参数化群同时也是流形，称为李群。, symmetric) objects, which constitute a group. A continuously-parameterized group that is also a manifold is called a Lie group.

3 方法Methods

由于商空间代表了具有对称性的系统的“基本状态”，因此预计将在此基础上建立系统的原理扩散模型。在本节中，我们通过将投影扩散过程推导到商空间上来展开商空间扩散模型的发展，然后将其提升回总空间（As the quotient space represents the “essential states” of a system with symmetry, a principled diffusion model for the system is expected to be built on it. In this section, we unroll the development of the quotient-space diffusion model by deriving the projected diffusion process onto the quotient space, then lift it back into the total space (即i.e.，原空格）以方便实施。然后我们得出专业化, the original space) for convenient implementation. We then derive the specialization in theR3​N/SE​(3)\mathbb{R}^{3N}/\mathrm{SE}(3)分子结构生成的情况，然后是训练和采样算法。最后，我们通过与现有对称处理的比较分析，强调了商空间扩散在降低训练难度和采样器有效性方面的优点。case for molecular structure generation, followed by training and sampling algorithms. Finally we highlight the merit of the quotient-space diffusion in reducing training difficulty and sampler validity with a comparative analysis with existing symmetry treatments.

3.3 实际实施Practical Implementations

之前的结果描述了我们如何使用总空间中的坐标在商空间中构建扩散过程。如果我们在整个空间上有一个扩散过程，我们可以构造其投影过程的水平升力，该投影过程沿着其轨迹没有垂直速度，并且这两个过程在商空间上是相同的。这一事实意味着原始扩散过程的垂直分量不是可有可无的，使我们能够设计一种基于商结构的更有效的扩散模型训练和采样算法。在实际中，我们经常将总空间设置为欧几里得空间。 接下来，我们展示特殊情况的训练和采样方法Previous results describe how we can construct a diffusion process in the quotient space using the coordinates in the total space. If we have a diffusion process on the total space, we can construct the horizontal lift of its projection process, which has no vertical velocity along its trajectory and the two processes are the same on quotient space. This fact implies that the vertical components of the original diffusion process are not dispensable and enables us to design a more efficient training and sampling algorithm of the diffusion model based on the quotient structure. In practice, we often set the total space as the Euclidean space. Next, we show the training and sampling methods for the special casepprior=𝒩​(𝟎,𝐈)p_{\mathrm{prior}}=\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},\mathbf{I})，一般情况如附录所示。, and the general case is shown in Appx.E.

4 实验Experiments

在本节中，我们研究商空间扩散模型的经验性能。我们仔细进行了多项涵盖不同类型数据、规模和场景的实验。为了评估我们的商空间扩散模型框架在现实世界中的应用，我们专注于分子结构生成蛋白质主干设计任务，其中我们考虑了扩散模型In this section, we study the empirical performance of our quotient-space diffusion model. We carefully conduct several experiments covering different types of data, scales and scenarios. The alignment-based methods fail to recover this distribution, with performance metrics falling short of even data-augmented, semi-equivariant baselines. We attribute this failure to a fundamental incompatibility between their samplers and the learned models. Furthermore, our formulation effectively reduces learning difficulty by removing the need to learn a specific target in redundant spatial transformations, enabling the model to capture key structural features more efficiently than standard semi-equivariant baselines. This advantage of efficiency leads to significant results: our 60M parameter model not only surpasses its direct baseline across both SDE at all noise scales and ODE sampling setting, but also outperforms the much larger 200MℳFS\mathcal{M}_{\text{FS}}基于大多数关键分布指标的模型。这提供了令人信服的证据，证明确保采样保真度和学习效率的商空间框架是推进生成蛋白质模型的关键。model on most key distributional metrics. This provides compelling evidence that a quotient space framework ensuring both sampling fidelity and learning efficiency is key to advancing generative protein models.

5 结论Conclusion

在这项工作中，我们正式构建了一个框架，用于在群上的商空间上构建扩散模型，希望有一种原则性的方法来处理生成任务中的对称性。我们明确地给出了商空间上的扩散过程的表达式，然后在原始空间中构造了相应的扩散过程，以便于实现。由此产生的训练算法通过消除预测沿群体动作方向的切向量的需要来降低学习难度，并且由此产生的采样过程保证产生目标分布，同时消除群体动作方向上不必要的运动。 我们在以下情况下实例化该方法In this work, we formally construct a framework for building diffusion models on the quotient space over a group, in hope for a principled approach to handle symmetry in a generative task. We explicitly give the expression of the diffusion process on the quotient space, then also construct a corresponding diffusion process in the original space for easier implementation. The resulting training algorithm reduces learning difficulty by removing the need to predict the tangent vector in the direction along group action, and the resulting sampling process guarantees producing the target distribution while removes the unnecessary movement in the group-action direction. We instantiate the method in the case ofR3​N/SE​(3)\mathbb{R}^{3N}/\mathrm{SE}(3)用于分子结构生成。 来自 GEOM-QM9 和 GEOM-DRUGS 数据集的小分子结构采样和蛋白质主干生成的经验结果表明，在相同或更少的训练时期下，与现有的传统等变扩散模型和基于比对的方法相比，具有更好的生成质量和设计成功率，证明了该原则框架在处理扩散模型中的对称性方面的实际优势。for molecular structure generation. Empirical results on structure sampling for small molecules from the GEOM-QM9 and GEOM-DRUGS datasets and protein backbone generation demonstrate the better generation quality and design success rate over existing conventional equivariant diffusion models and alignment-based approaches given equal or fewer training epochs, demonstrating the practical advantages from this principled framework to handling symmetry in diffusion models.

由于商具有黎曼流形结构，之前的一些工作都是在黎曼流形上构建扩散模型。As the quotient has the Riemannian manifold structure, several previous works construct the diffusion model on the Riemannian manifolds.de2022riemannian使用流形的不同重叠局部坐标系构建扩散模型，并需要测地随机游走来模拟前向过程。constructs diffusion models using different overlapping local coordinate systems of the manifold and requires geodesic random walk to simulate the forward process.huang2022riemannian; chen2023flow在嵌入空间中构建扩散模型，该模型允许全局表示，但需要显式的流形测地线公式。construct diffusion models in an embedding space which allows a global representation but requires explicit geodesic formula of the manifold.zhu2024trivialized在李群上构造朗之万动力学的逆函数来执行生成建模。这种方法不是为商空间设计的，也不容易适用于商空间，商空间具有与李群不同的几何结构。 在我们的商空间案例中，商结构的特殊性使我们能够使用总空间的坐标系构建扩散模型，而不依赖于商在总空间中的嵌入（不必要的嵌入空间），这更实用但仍然通用。constructs the reverse of kinetic Langevin dynamics on a Lie group to perform generative modeling. Such an approach is not designed for and not readily applicable to the quotient space, which has a different geometric structure from the Lie group. In our quotient space case, the specialty with a quotient structure enables us to construct diffusion models using the coordinate systems of the total space without relying on an embedding of the quotient in the total space (unnecessarily an embedding space), which is more practical to implement yet still general.

几何扩散模型。Geometric diffusion models.

为了确保生成过程中的物理对称性，主流策略将基本物理约束（例如 SE(3) 等方差）直接集成到扩散模型架构中。这种方法由 EDM 等模型首创To ensure physical symmetry in the generation process, a mainstream strategy integrates fundamental physical constraints, such as SE(3) equivariance, directly into the diffusion-model architecture. This approach, pioneered by models like EDM(hoogeboom2022equivariant)，通常采用 EGNN 直接在原子坐标上运行，使用零质心调整等技术来保证平移不变性。这一基本概念随后在几个方向上得到扩展。例如，该方法适用于 EDM-Bridge 等模型中的扩散桥, typically employs an EGNN to operate directly on atomic coordinates, using techniques like zero center of mass adjustments to guarantee translational invariance. This foundational concept was subsequently extended in several directions. 协调学习Learning with alignment

为了降低学习难度，人们提出了一些启发式处理（对齐学习），希望减少与对称群动作对应的自由度。 GeoDiff中使用的对齐策略To reduce learning difficulty, some heuristic treatments (learning with alignment) have been proposed in hope to reduce the DoFs corresponding to the symmetry group action. The alignment strategy used in GeoDiff(xu2022geodiff)通过找到最小化目标结构与噪声输入之间距离的最佳刚性变换，将目标结构与噪声输入对齐。 AlphaFold 3 (AF3) 中提出的另一种方法aligns the target structure to the noisy input by finding an optimal rigid transformation that minimizes the distance between them. Another approach, proposed in AlphaFold 3 (AF3)(abramson2024accurate)，将目标样本与模型输出结构对齐。正如正文中所讨论的，这两种基于对齐的训练框架缺乏恢复正确目标分布的明确保证，并且与采样过程不兼容。波尔兹-1, aligns the target samples to the model output structure. As discussed in the main text, these two alignment-based training frameworks lack a definite guarantee for recovering the correct target distribution, and is incompatible with the sampling process. Boltz-1(wohlwend2025boltz)AF3 的开源复制品注意到了这个问题，并提出了对采样的修改，以便在更新之前将去噪结构与当前生成步骤中的结构对齐。尽管如此，正如第 2 节中所讨论的。, an open-source replication of AF3, noticed this issue and proposed a modification in sampling to align the denoised structure to the structure in the current generation step before updating. Nevertheless, as discussed in Sec.3.4，这个和AF3的训练协议一起，相当于GeoDiff的操作，仍然质疑采样过程。, this, together with the training protocol of AF3, amounts to the operation of GeoDiff, still questioning the sampling process.

光滑流形是一种拓扑结构。如果我们想定义“速度的长度”和流形上两点之间的距离，则需要切线空间上的度量。这样的度量赋予了度量额外的几何结构。正式定义如下。Smooth manifold is a topological structure. If we want to define the ”length of the velocity” and distance between two points on the manifold, a metric on the tangent space is required. Such a metric endows the metric with an additional geometry structure. The formal definitions are as follows.

A 黎曼度量Riemannian metric在光滑流形上是与每个点相关联的对应关系on a smooth manifold is a correspondence which associates to each pointpp of ℳ\mathcal{M}内积an inner product⟨⋅,⋅⟩x\left\langle\cdot,\cdot\right\rangle_{x}平滑地变化that varies smoothly onℳ\mathcal{M}。换句话说，对于任意两个平滑向量场. In other words, for any two smooth vector fields𝐮,𝐯\mathbf{u},\mathbf{v}, ⟨𝐮,𝐯⟩\left\langle\mathbf{u},\mathbf{v}\right\rangle是一个平滑函数is a smooth function onℳ\mathcal{M}。具有给定黎曼度量的光滑流形称为. A smooth manifold with a given Riemannian metric is called a黎曼流形Riemannian manifold.

为了定义切空间不同点之间的“差异”，我们需要引入一个称为仿射连接的概念。To define the ”difference” between tangent space at different points, we need to introduce a concept called affine connection.

一个连接称为A connection is called the莱维-奇维塔连接Levi-Civita connectionif 满足以下附加属性：if satisfies the following additional properties:

Levi-Civita 连接是具有良好特性的连接。它的存在和唯一性是黎曼几何的基本结果。The Levi-Civita connection is the connection with nice properties. Its existence and uniqueness is a fundamental result of Riemannian geometry.

定理17Theorem 17.

（黎曼几何基本定理(Fundamental Theorem of Riemannian Geometry(lee2018introduction, Thm. 5.10)) 假设) Assume(ℳ,⟨⋅,⋅⟩)(\mathcal{M},\left\langle\cdot,\cdot\right\rangle)是黎曼流形。那么就存在独特的列维-奇维塔联系。is a Riemannian manifold. Then there exists a unique Levi-Civita connection.

B.2 流形上的随机微积分Stochastic Calculus on a Manifold

利用上一节中定义的黎曼结构，我们可以考虑流形上随机微分方程（SDE）和扩散过程的定义。对于该主题的系统处理，请参阅标准教科书With the Riemannian structure defined in the previous section, we can consider the definition of stochastic differential equations (SDE) and diffusion processes on the manifold. 对于随机微分几何，Stratonovitch 积分比 Itô 积分更方便。 Stratonovitch微分有效地将维纳过程的确定性二阶效应从二次变分纳入漂移项，从而满足微积分的普通链式法则。 这一性质使得两个黎曼流形之间的微分同胚下的扩散过程之间具有清晰的对应关系。接下来，我们给出了欧几里得空间上斯特拉托诺维奇积分的定义及其对黎曼流形的推广。For stochastic differential geometry, the Stratonovitch integral is more convenient than the Itô Integral. The Stratonovitch differential effectively subsumes the deterministic second-order effect of the Wiener process from the quadratic variation into the drift term, so that it satisfies the ordinary chain rule of calculus. This property enables a clear correspondence between the diffusion process under a diffeomorphism between two Riemannian manifolds. 群作用通常表示对称性，即可以通过群作用相互转换的点被视为对称，The group action typically represents a symmetry in the sense that points that can be transformed to each other by a group action are regarded as symmetric,即i.e.，它们是等价的。 因此，我们可以定义一个等价关系, they are equivalent. Therefore, we can define an equivalence relation∼\sim on ℳ\mathcal{M} as 𝐱∼𝐱′\mathbf{x}\sim\mathbf{x}^{\prime} if ∃g∈𝒢,𝐱′=g⋅𝐱\exists g\in\mathcal{G},\mathbf{x}^{\prime}=g\cdot\mathbf{x}。具有代表性的等价类. The equivalence class with representative𝐱\mathbf{x}定义为所有等价于的点的集合is defined as the set of all points that are equivalent to𝐱\mathbf{x}。 商空间. The quotient space𝒬:=ℳ/𝒢\mathcal{Q}:=\mathcal{M}/\mathcal{G}（作为一个集合）在此等价关系下定义，它由以下关系下的等价类组成(as a set) is defined under this equivalence relation, which consists of equivalence classes under the relation∼\sim。 原来的空间. The original spaceℳ\mathcal{M}称为总空间。 有一种称为投影的自然映射，它连接总空间和商空间，它映射任何is referred to as the total space. There is a natural mapping called projection that connects the total space and the quotient space, which maps any𝐱∈ℳ\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{M}到它所代表的等价类。在这种情况下，等价性由李群定义，投影映射可以写为：to the equivalence class it represents. π:ℳ→𝒬,π​(𝐱):={g⋅𝐱∣g∈𝒢}.\displaystyle\pi:\mathcal{M}\to\mathcal{Q},\;\pi(\mathbf{x}):=\{g\cdot\mathbf{x}\mid g\in\mathcal{G}\}. (39)

Therefore, it can be understood that an equivalence class is a “representation” (literal meaning; not the mathematical concept) of the Lie group, hence can also adopt manifold structures of𝒢\mathcal{G}在上述“良好”条件下。 另外，under the mentioned “good” conditions. Intuitively, the first constraint∑n=1Nv→(n)=0→\sum_{n=1}^{N}\vec{v}^{(n)}=\vec{0}意味着系统的总（线性）动量为零，意味着运动保持点云的CoM，means the total (linear) momentum of the system is zero, meaning that the movement keeps the CoM of the point cloud,即i.e.，总/刚性平移自由度是固定的。 第二个约束, the total/rigid translational degree of freedom is fixed. The second constraint∑n=1Nx→(n)×v→(n)=0→\sum_{n=1}^{N}\vec{x}^{(n)}\times\vec{v}^{(n)}=\vec{0}意味着系统的总角动量为零，意味着整体上没有净旋转，means the total angular momentum of the system is zero, meaning that there is no net rotation as a whole,即i.e.，总/刚性旋转自由度是固定的。 因此，水平空间中的向量对应于不在等价类内移动、而是纯粹跨等价类移动的运动。, the total/rigid rotational degree of freedom is fixed. Therefore, vectors in the horizontal space correspond to movements that does not move within an equivalence class, but purely across equivalence classes.

鉴于水平空间的构造（Given the construction of the horizontal space (即i.e.，“连接”），可以导出商空间切向量（和向量场）的水平升力。作为, a “connection”), the horizontal lift for a quotient-space tangent vector (and vector field) can be derived. AsSO​(3)\mathrm{SO}(3)动作流畅、自如、正确、等距acts smoothly, freely, properly, and isometrically onℳ\mathcal{M}，可以导出黎曼结构, a Riemannian structure can be induced for𝒬\mathcal{Q}从那from that ofℳ\mathcal{M}，它继承自标准欧几里得度量。 由于水平提升向量场是水平的，根据上述直觉，它引起纯粹跨等价类的运动，使其与商空间上的向量场完美对应，并避免等价类内的“不必要”运动。, which is inherited from the standard Euclidean metric. Since the horizontal-lifted vector field is horizontal, by the above intuition, it induces a movement purely across equivalence classes, making it a perfect correspondence to a vector field on the quotient space, and avoiding “unnecessary” movements that are within an equivalence class.

总空间的扩散模型The diffusion model on the total spaceℳ\mathcal{M}由去噪分数匹配目标进行训练。由于速度的垂直分量不是严格需要的，因此我们建议仅在水平分量上监督模型，并允许模型的任意垂直输出。回想一下水平投影算子is trained by the denoising score matching objective. 数值稳定性。Numerical stability.

在我们的商空间扩散模型框架中，我们需要计算矩阵求逆In our quotient-space diffusion model framework, we need to calculate the matrix inversion of𝐊\mathbf{K}，对于近共线的点系统可能存在数值问题。在实践中，我们添加一个, which may have numerical issues for near-collinear systems of points. In practice, we add anϵ​𝐈\epsilon\mathbf{I}进行矩阵求逆之前的项，即我们计算term before conducting matrix inversion, that is, we calculate(ϵ​𝐈+𝐊)−1(\epsilon\mathbf{I}+\mathbf{K})^{-1}在实践中，其中in practice, where𝐈\mathbf{I}是is the3×33\times 3单位矩阵。 这种处理在面临类似情况的算法中被广泛采用，identity matrix. This treatment is widely adopted in algorithms facing similar situations,例如e.g.，Kabsch-Umeyama 对齐算法的实际实现。 我们的典型选择, the practical implementation of the Kabsch-Umeyama algorithm for alignment. Our typical choice ofϵ\epsilon为1e-8，我们发现在此设置下训练过程是稳定的。我们在图 2 中展示了模型在蛋白质主干生成任务上的训练曲线。is 1e-8, and we found that the training process is stable under this setting. We have shown the training curve of the model on the protein backbone generation task in Fig.4，这表明在训练过程中没有出现数值问题。, which indicates no numerical issues arise during the training process.

F.3 训练和采样加速Training and Sampling Acceleration

在本小节中，我们研究不同方法的训练和采样收敛速度。为了比较训练收敛速度，我们在图 2 中绘制了通过精度 AMR 中值度量相对于先前启发式对齐方法和商空间扩散模型的训练时期测量的生成性能。In this subsection, we study the training and sampling convergence speed of different methods. For the training convergence speed comparison, we plot the generation performance measured by the precision AMR median metric with respect to the training epochs for previous heuristic alignment methods and our quotient-space diffusion model in Fig.5（左）。我们只关注所有方法的前 100 个 epoch。这些模型使用相同的架构 ET-Flow 进行训练（(Left). We only focus on the first 100 epochs for all the methods. These models are trained with the same architecture ET-Flow (SO​(3)\mathrm{SO}(3)）以及 GEOM-DRUGS 数据集上的训练配置。结果表明，我们的方法实现了与 AF3 启发式方法相似的收敛速度，因为两种方法都降低了模型的学习难度，如表所示) and training configurations on the GEOM-DRUGS dataset. The results indicate that our method achieves a similar convergence speed to the AF3 heuristic method, because both methods reduce the learning difficulty of the model, as shown in Table1。这一理论上的优势使得收敛速度比 GeoDiff 对齐方法更快。我们还注意到，在 80 个训练周期后，AF3 对齐方法的生成性能开始变差。发生这种情况是由于训练损失和生成性能指标之间的不兼容，因为 AF3 方法最初是为蛋白质结构预测任务设计的，而不是通过分布指标来评估的。. This theoretical benefit leads to faster convergence than the GeoDiff alignment method. We also notice that the AF3 alignment method starts to get worse generation performance after 80 training epochs. This happens due to the incompatibility between the training loss and the generation performance metric, as the AF3 method is originally designed for the protein structure prediction task, which is not evaluated by distributional metrics.

为了比较采样收敛速度，我们绘制了通过精度 AMR 中值度量测量的生成性能相对于采样过程的函数评估 (NFE) 数量的情况，如图 1 所示。For the sampling convergence speed comparison, we plot the generation performance measured by the precision AMR median metric with respect to the number of function evaluations (NFE) for the sampling process in Fig.5（右）。对于在 GEOM-DRUGS 数据集上训练的所有这些方法，我们使用 Flow Matching ODE 采样器(Right). For all these methods trained on the GEOM-DRUGS dataset, we use the Flow Matching ODE sampler(lipman2023flow)用欧拉离散化。从结果中，我们可以观察到使用不同策略训练的模型表现出相似的收敛趋势（随着 NFE 的降低，性能逐渐下降），我们的商空间扩散框架在每个 NFE 设置中始终优于所有基线。with Euler discretization. From the results, we can observe that models trained with different strategies exhibit similar convergence trends (performance gradually degrades as NFE decreases), our quotient-space diffusion framework consistently outperforms all baselines across every NFE setting.

G.2.1 数据集Dataset

对于训练，我们利用 Foldseek AFDB 集群（For training, we utilize the Foldseek AFDB clusters (DFSD_{\text{FS}}）数据集在 Proteína 中策划和描述。 该数据集是 AlphaFold 数据库 (AFDB) 的高质量、非冗余子集，包含 588,318 个簇代表性蛋白质结构，长度在 32 到 256 个残基之间。 该数据集使用分层 CATH 标签进行注释，这些标签在训练期间得到利用。 我们的数据处理和处理严格遵循附录 M 中详述的流程) dataset as curated and described in the Proteína. This dataset is a high-quality, non-redundant subset of the AlphaFold Database (AFDB), containing 588,318 cluster-representative protein structures with lengths between 32 and 256 residues. The dataset is annotated with hierarchical CATH labels, which are leveraged during training. Our data processing and handling strictly follow the pipeline detailed in Appendix M of(geffner2025proteina).

G.2.3 取样Sampling

为了便于与公开可用的 Proteína 检查点进行直接比较，我们使用相同的分层折叠类调节机制来训练我们的模型。 然而，为了确保对基础生成能力的公平评估，我们正文中报告的所有实验都是在严格无条件的环境下进行的。 我们在所有模型中应用了相同的采样协议，使用 400 个采样步骤并启用自我调节，这不断提高了性能。 没有使用其他制导技术，例如自动制导。 我们使用确定性 ODE 采样来评估分布保真度，并使用 SDE 采样来探索可设计性与多样性的权衡。 我们采用了 SDE 公式及其 Euler-Maruyama 数值方案，详细信息请参见附录 ITo facilitate a direct comparison with the publicly available Proteína checkpoints, we trained our model with an identical hierarchical fold class conditioning mechanism. However, to ensure a fair assessment of foundational generative capabilities, all experiments reported in our main text were performed in a strictly unconditional setting. We applied the same sampling protocol across all models, using 400 sampling steps and enabling self-conditioning, which consistently improved performance. No other guidance techniques, such as autoguidance, were utilized. We use deterministic ODE sampling to assess distributional fidelity and SDE sampling to explore the designability-diversity trade-off. We adapt the SDE formulation and its Euler-Maruyama numerical scheme, detailed in Appendix I of(geffner2025proteina)，对于我们的商空间框架，同时保留所有其他配置，例如采样调度程序和, for our quotient space framework, while retaining all other configurations, such as the sampling scheduler andg​(t)g(t)，来自原始论文。, from the original paper.

G.2.4 评价Evaluation

我们严格遵守 Proteína 论文中建立和验证的指标来评估我们的模型。 我们使用蛋白质设计中的标准指标套件来评估模型性能：We evaluate our models rigorously adheres to the metrics established and validated in the Proteína paper. We assess model performance using the standard suite of metrics in protein design:

  • •

    可设计性。Designability.通过自洽 RMSD (scRMSD) 协议进行定量，使用 ProteinMPNN 进行反向折叠，使用 ESMFold 进行结构预测，scRMSD 的成功阈值小于 2Å。Quantified by the self-consistency RMSD (scRMSD) protocol, using ProteinMPNN for inverse folding and ESMFold for structure prediction, with a success threshold of scRMSD less than 2Å.

  • •

    多样性。Diversity.以两种方式测量：通过可设计样本中的平均成对 TM 分数，以及通过 Foldseek 在 TM 分数阈值 0.5 下识别的不同结构簇的数量。Measured in two ways: by the average pairwise TM-score among designable samples, and by the number of distinct structural clusters identified by Foldseek at a TM-score threshold of 0.5.

  • •

    新奇。Novelty.通过根据 PDB 和 AFDB 数据库中的参考结构计算每个可设计样本的最大 TM 分数来进行评估。Assessed by calculating the maximum TM-score of each designable sample against reference structures in the PDB and AFDB databases.

我们还采用了由We also adopt the novel probabilistic metrics introduced by(geffner2025proteina)，衡量我们的模型捕捉蛋白质结构真实分布的程度：, to measure how well our model captures the true distribution of protein structures:

  • •

    FPSD。FPSD.测量预训练折叠类预测器的特征空间中生成的结构和参考结构之间的分布相似性。Measured the distributional similarity between generated and reference structures in the feature space of a pre-trained fold class predictor.

  • •

    fS。fS.根据折叠类别预测的置信度和熵评估样本的质量和多样性。Evaluated both the quality and diversity of samples based on the confidence and entropy of fold class predictions.

  • •

    fJSD。fJSD.量化生成集和参考集的分类折叠类分布之间的相似性。Quantified the similarity between the categorical fold class distributions of generated and reference sets.

值得注意的是，我们从正文中省略了多样性和新颖性指标，以避免与文献中可能不准确的结果进行比较。 此决定基于最近在 v10 之前的 FoldSeek 版本（版本 10-941cd33）的 alntmscore 输出中发现的错误，该错误导致许多先前报告的基于 TM 的指标不正确（也可以在It is noteworthy that we have omitted the Diversity and Novelty metrics from our main text to avoid comparisons with potentially inaccurate results in the literature. This decision is based on a bug recently identified in the alntmscore output of FoldSeek versions prior to v10 (release 10-941cd33), which renders many previously reported TM-based metrics incorrect (also found in(daras2025ambient)）。 为了提供受控且准确的基准测试，我们使用 FoldSeek v10（版本 10-941cd33）进行了自己的分析。 我们将这种重新评估限制为已发布的小型 Proteína 模型以及在商空间中训练的相应模型。表中总结了此比较的完整结果). To provide a controlled and accurate benchmark, we conducted our own analysis using the FoldSeek v10 (release 10-941cd33).
